_doc: The trainer card's badge page (b2tools/patches/trainer_card.py): Sinnoh's Gym Leaders in Pearl's badge order, Pearl's own text (b2tools/gen4_text.py). Per leader: the city and name (Black 2's line format, Pearl's names), the motto from Pearl's Gym sign (banks 58, 78, 135, 123, 98, 47, 167, 153), a line the leader says in Pearl (60/0, 81/5, 136/5, 125/5, 104/5, 49/5, 169/0, 156/0), the badge's name (60/2 ... 156/2). Black 2's obedience lines after each badge are kept: the game uses Black 2's rule, which is Pearl's (Lv. 20 + 10 per badge, all with the eighth).

btl_server_flow_4.BtlServerFlow4_Text_EveryoneHasDifferent: I’m but one Trainer who decided to\nwalk proudly with Rock-type Pokémon!
btl_server_flow_4.BtlServerFlow4_Text_ItsKindnessSayNo: You and your Pokémon are gonna get\neven tougher, and I mean seriously!
btl_server_flow_4.BtlServerFlow4_Text_UmmThatsRightUse: But being with Pokémon lets us\nkeep making the effort, doesn’t it?
btl_server_flow_4.BtlServerFlow4_Text_IfShineInnerLight: The styles of battling and winning\nare as widely varied as Trainers are.
btl_server_flow_4.BtlServerFlow4_Text_DontLieYerselfIts: Have patience! You must become\nstronger, one at a time.
btl_server_flow_4.BtlServerFlow4_Text_HighflyingGirl: The Man with the Steel Body!
btl_server_flow_4.BtlServerFlow4_Text_SincereTrainerFlexib: Pokémon, fashion, romance...\nIt’s all about focus!
btl_server_flow_4.BtlServerFlow4_Text_ItsClicheCompareLife: I hope you’re the Trainer who’ll make\nme remember how fun it is to battle!
